scenes.text: There's a blue planet where scientists think it rains glass, sideways.
It's called HD one eight nine seven three three b, about sixty-three light years away.
From far away it looks deep blue, a bit like Earth.
But it's a giant ball of gas hugging its star, hotter than a thousand degrees Celsius.
Scientists think its blue color comes from tiny drops of melted glass in the air.
And winds of around seven thousand kilometers per hour blow that glass rain sideways.
Would you visit, even for one second?

title: This blue planet rains glass sideways 🌧️
caption: HD 189733b looks blue like Earth, but scientists think the color comes from molten glass in its atmosphere, blown sideways by winds around 7,000 km/h. 🔵
